tagline.en: PKU-YuanGroup's open text-to-video project — MIT-licensed v1.3 weights that turn prompts into short clips.
tagline.zh: 北大 PKU-YuanGroup 的开源文生视频项目——MIT 许可的 v1.3 权重,将提示词转为短片。

en: Open-Sora-Plan is an open text-to-video project from PKU-YuanGroup, with model releases published under the LanguageBind organization on Hugging Face. You give it a text prompt and it generates a short video clip.

The current v1.3.0 release is MIT-licensed and pairs the video model with Google's mt5-xxl text encoder for prompt understanding. The project also has a line of earlier public releases, so v1.3.0 is the recommended route here.

In WorldFoundry, Open-Sora-Plan runs through the shared pipeline — provide a prompt and it renders a video. Because the mt5-xxl text encoder is a large separate component, it is staged alongside the model checkpoint.
zh: Open-Sora-Plan 是北大 PKU-YuanGroup 的开源文生视频项目,模型在 Hugging Face 上以 LanguageBind 组织名发布。你给它一段文字提示词,它生成一段短视频片段。
当前的 v1.3.0 版本采用 MIT 许可,并将视频模型与 Google 的 mt5-xxl 文本编码器配对以理解提示词。项目还有一系列更早的公开版本,因此这里推荐使用 v1.3.0 路径。
在 WorldFoundry 中,Open-Sora-Plan 通过统一 pipeline 运行——给出提示词即可渲染视频。由于 mt5-xxl 文本编码器是一个较大的独立组件,它会与模型 checkpoint 一同准备。

whenToUse.en: Use Open-Sora-Plan when you want an openly-licensed, MIT text-to-video model to prototype prompt-driven clip generation.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用一个开放、MIT 许可的文生视频模型做提示词驱动的片段生成原型时,可以使用 Open-Sora-Plan。

notFor.en: The mt5-xxl text encoder is a large separate download, so plan for extra disk space and download time before a run.
notFor.zh: mt5-xxl 文本编码器是一个较大的独立下载项,运行前请预留额外的磁盘空间与下载时间。
